notes.title: Patch Live! Improved controls and gamepad support!
notes.content:
Hello!

As promised, the new update is available. We have improved the controls, fixed some bugs and we have added support for gamepad!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/1da39e59e181290680c41a2e5d7aa61572acf2b9.jpg

We hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think at our Community Hub.

Have a great summer! And stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Release date set in Stone!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/72626fe618fc6c9d7ebcd54ede8e13aeb6725908.jpg

May 30th 

On May 30th the game will be available and to celebrate its launch and thank everyone for their support on the Greenlight campaign, it will be available at a 15% discount during its first week on Steam. 

In the mean time check out the announcement teaser and we will be really happy if you join us at our Community Hub and share your opinions and questions.

We hope you enjoy the game when released!
